companyInfo.title: 1. Company Information
companyInfo.description: MedCure is an online medical appointment booking platform, operated by MedCure Technology JSC.

purpose.title: 2. Purpose and Scope of Operations
purpose.description: MedCure provides a service connecting patients and healthcare facilities (hospitals, clinics, doctors) for online medical appointments. We do not directly provide medical services but act as an intermediary platform.

userResponsibilities.title: 3. User Responsibilities
userResponsibilities.description: When using MedCure services, users commit to:
items: Providing accurate, complete, and up-to-date information
Complying with booking and cancellation regulations
Not using the service for illegal purposes
Securing account information and not sharing it with third parties
Respecting the rights of doctors and healthcare facilities

bookingcareResponsibilities.title: 4. MedCure Responsibilities
items: Protecting user personal information in accordance with legal regulations
Providing stable, secure, and convenient services
Handling user complaints fairly and promptly
Complying with legal regulations on personal data protection

liabilityLimitation.title: 5. Liability Limitation
liabilityLimitation.description1: MedCure is not responsible for the quality of medical services provided by doctors or healthcare facilities. Responsibility for diagnosis, treatment, and healthcare belongs to the doctors and healthcare facilities that provided the services.
liabilityLimitation.description2: MedCure is not responsible for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use the service.

intellectualProperty.title: 6. Intellectual Property Rights
intellectualProperty.description: All content on the MedCure website, including logos, images, text, software, and other assets, is owned by MedCure or licensed for use. Users are not permitted to copy, use, or distribute any content without written permission from MedCure.

changes.title: 7. Changes and Updates
changes.description: MedCure reserves the right to change, update, or supplement the terms in this legal notice without prior notice. Users should regularly check for the latest updates.

lawAndDisputes.title: 8. Applicable Law and Dispute Resolution
lawAndDisputes.description: This legal notice is governed by Vietnamese law. Any disputes arising will be resolved through negotiation. If no agreement is reached, disputes will be brought to a competent court in Vietnam for resolution.
